ctx.x: player so I brought in Eddie "Lockjaw" Davis to play the hot tenor so I could (inaudible) conduct the band.

Well, back when you were with Chick's band and you were straw boss and you were musical director and so forth, were there any difficulties -- particular difficulties that you had with musicians? What about also getting the band uniforms cleaned? Were you responsible for that?
